page_title: ATM 3-1 LEV | Atletico Madrid v Levante 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jesus Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+6' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' After what seems an eternity, referee Jesus Manzano decides NO GOAL for Atl. Madrid after the VAR review! Play to continue.
90+4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Levante players look gutted.
90+1' The Levante players halt their celebrations as referee Jesus Manzano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) controls the ball from the free kick and from the edge of the box wallops it into the bottom left corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
89' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Mathew Ryan to dive and make a save.
88' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle after Kervin Arriaga (Levante) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Atl. Madrid are awarded the free kick.
87' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gets a yellow card.
86' The game is interrupted as Jose Morales (Levante) is flagged offside.
86' Here comes a substitution. Victor Garcia (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Jeremy Toljan.
86' Julian Calero has decided to make a change. Alan Matturro (Levante) replaces Manu Sanchez.
85' That will be all from Unai Elgezabal Udondo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Oriol Rey (Levante).
84' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jesus Manzano ignores the protests.
82' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
82' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
80' 3 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:1.

80' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Mathew Ryan leaps like a salmon to deny him.
80' The attendance for today's match is 60119.
79' Substitution. Alex Baena leaves the pitch and is replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
79' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Matteo Ruggeri and he is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).

77' Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
77' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Levante.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Goduine Koyalipou (Levante). Good work from Levante as they win a corner.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Morales (Levante) is coming onto the pitch as Roger Brugue cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Julian Calero decides to make a substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti will be replaced by Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
73' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Giuliano Simeone.
72' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
70' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will take the corner.
67' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
65' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

64' What a chance that is! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Marcos Llorente feeds Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
61' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Pablo Barrios is replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
61' A substitution has been made. Alexander Sorloth is replaced by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
59' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
59' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
59' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

57' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
57' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
55' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
53' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes it short.
51' The linesman raises his flag. Manu Sanchez (Levante) is adjudged offside.
48' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

47' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
46' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45+1' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+1' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will take a corner kick.

44' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.

43' A huge rebound finds Jeremy Toljan (Levante) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
43' Levante will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
41' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.

41' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Today's referee Jesus Manzano rightly decides to book Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) for his harsh tackle.

40' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Mathew Ryan pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
39' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
38' Atl. Madrid take a short corner kick.
35' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' The game is interrupted now, Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
30' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
29' PENALTY APPEAL after Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
26' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
25' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
23' A clumsy foul by Manu Sanchez (Levante) and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.

21' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Manu Sanchez (Levante) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the left post. 1:1.
21' The referee points to the corner flag and Levante will take a corner.
19' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
16' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Levante in a dangerous position.
14' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
12' 1 - 0 Own goal! Dela (Levante) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:0.
9' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
7' Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
7' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
1' The match has just started.
Atl. Madrid will kick-off.
Jesus Manzano will supervise the game today.
